one_line: Early Gurjara-Pratihara war leader who defended northwestern India in the mid-8th century.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but solidly built, with the wiry strength of a seasoned cavalry commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-deep brown complexion (northwestern Indian), high cheekbones, neatly trimmed moustache that curves slightly upward, short close beard along the jawline, sharp dark eyes with a focused, alert gaze; default expression is calm and strategic, as if quietly sizing up a battlefield.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a compact topknot at the back of the crown, sides neatly smoothed, with a few short strands escaping near the temples; he wears a narrow reddish-brown cloth headband tied at the back, just above the forehead, with no metal crown or diadem.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton kurta in muted off-white with a simple round neck slit at the front, over which sits a fitted sleeveless quilted gambeson-style vest in deep maroon, lightly padded and stitched in vertical lines; his lower body is clad in narrow churidar-style trousers in dusty indigo tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching, historically plausible for a mounted warrior; tied at his waist is a broad woven cloth belt in dark red with thin mustard-yellow stripes, securing a practical scabbard; over one shoulder he drapes a plain, unpatterned ochre cotton angavastra (shawl) that can be thrown back in motion; he wears minimal jewellery—small plain copper studs in the ears and a simple black-thread amulet cord at the neck—reflecting a martial, frontier setting.
appearance.signature: A single-edged curved steel sword of early talwar-type with a plain iron hilt and disc pommel, carried at his left hip in a brown leather scabbard reinforced with simple iron bands, often held loosely in his right hand when posed.

ref_desc: Nagabhata I is a lean early-30s northwestern Indian warrior with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, trimmed moustache and jawline beard, black hair in a compact topknot with a reddish-brown headband, wearing an off-white kurta, deep maroon sleeveless quilted vest, dusty indigo churidar trousers, brown leather boots, an ochre shoulder-draped angavastra, a dark red striped waist-belt, minimal copper jewellery, and carrying a plain-hilt curved steel sword in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nagabhata I as a historically grounded mid-8th century northwestern Indian war leader: a lean early-30s man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, high cheekbones, straight nose, sharp dark eyes, a neatly trimmed upward-curving moustache and short jawline beard, and thick black hair pulled into a compact topknot with a narrow reddish-brown cloth headband tied at the back. Show him in an off-white, knee-length long-sleeved cotton kurta with a simple round neck and front slit, worn under a fitted sleeveless quilted gambeson-style vest in deep maroon with vertical stitching. Put him in narrow dusty indigo churidar-style trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching. Tie a broad dark red cloth belt with thin mustard-yellow stripes at his waist, securing a brown leather scabbard with iron bands. Drape an unpatterned ochre cotton angavastra diagonally over one shoulder and across the torso, leaving his silhouette clear. Add minimal jewellery: small plain copper ear studs and a thin black-thread amulet cord at the neck. His signature weapon is a single-edged curved steel sword with a plain iron hilt and disc pommel, carried at his left hip and also shown in hand in one pose. Use a muted palette of off-white, deep maroon, dusty indigo, ochre, and brown leather, and present him from front, side, and back to emphasize consistent hair, clothing, and sword details in a clean, shonen-anime visual style.
